candidates.claim: OUTSIDE_IN, bound inbound on the outside interface, permits tcp/22 from any source to 10.10.10.21 (an OT SCADA server), so Internet hosts can open SSH connections directly into the OT side.
candidates.remediation: Remove the permit at fw-01:59 from OUTSIDE_IN and route any remote administrative access through the DMZ jump host.

candidates.claim: The OUTSIDE_IN permit at fw-01:59 allows direct inbound tcp/22 from OUTSIDE to OT host 10.10.10.21, which is not an approved cross-zone service and bypasses DMZ mediation.
candidates.remediation: Remove the permit at fw-01:59 so that OUTSIDE traffic to the OT side is denied except through approved services.

candidates.claim: The access-list entry at fw-01:59 (access-list OUTSIDE_IN) is not in the approved baseline and was added in the current configuration.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the change against an approved change record or revert it to the baseline.
